rename.to: application built with vcpkg on x64 Windows crashing with exit code 0xc0000135

body: Just a guess, maybe this is a regression from #15474? I don't know what other recent changes could be relevant.
Regressions in libsamplerate #15954 and libsndfile #15953 could be other plausible explanations.

Hi @Be-ing 

Thanks for posting this issue.

Could you please tell us the steps to reproduce this issue? Thanks.
I'm working on figuring that out.

> Regressions in libsamplerate #15954 and libsndfile #15953 could be other plausible explanations.

I tried reverting these but that did not fix the error.
I tried reverting #15926, #16012, #16009, and #15677, but none of that made a difference.
Confirmed. There was a regression between libebur128 1.2.4 and 1.2.5.
